sku_type.note: babycreamlotion's dict identity column is sku_type (there is NO sku_type_complete column on this table; the QA table's sku_type_complete is populated from this value). sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Calamom Lotion', 'Pigeon Baby Water Gel Lotion Botanical'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. Empty sources are NOT skipped: the production convention is a raw CONCAT with a single-space separator, so an empty `scent` leaves a literal double space (e.g. 'Labore Barrier Revive Cream  10 ml', 'Kado Skin Daily Soothin Cream Multiceramide  100 ml'). Exact-concat holds on 1578/1719 rows; the rest are legacy drift (single space with empty scent, or a scent folded into sub_brand). New rows follow the 1578-row majority so downstream exact-string joins on sku_type keep matching.

keywords.note: Holds on 1719/1719 rows (100%). When keywords_typo is empty, keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type; otherwise the typo string is appended (e.g. keywords_typo='60ml' -> 'Calamom Lotion Lavender 60 ml 60ml'). Note the source ORDER is the reverse of babybath's.

packsize.note: Not generated but strongly conventionalised: '<number> <unit>' with a space, unit lowercase ('60 ml', '150 gr'). Pick-your-own / unknown-size rows use the literal 'Multi Variant' (also mirrored into gramasi/total_gramasi). Multi-item bundles join components with ' + '.

ingredients.note: When no ingredient is known, every ingredient_N column and `ingredients` are set to the literal 'Not Available' (dominant production convention), not left empty. Some rows list a 5th ingredient in `ingredients` that has no ingredient_N column.

gramasi.note: Numeric part of packsize as a STRING, no unit ('60', '150'); 'Multi Variant' when packsize is 'Multi Variant'. total_gramasi = gramasi * bundle_quantity for multipacks, equal to gramasi for singles.
